```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [150, 250, 350],
    "mar": [200, 300, 400]
}

df = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame(data))

# Reshape from wide to long format
df_long = df.melt(
    id_vars="id",
    value_vars=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales"
)

print(df_long.to_native())
```
